# Recommended labels

Create these labels in the GitHub repository settings after publication:

| Label | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `good first issue` | Small, documented tasks appropriate for first-time contributors. |
| `help wanted` | Work where maintainer help from the community is especially welcome. |
| `needs triage` | Newly reported issue that needs reproduction or classification. |
| `bug` | Confirmed incorrect behavior. |
| `documentation` | Documentation-only work. |
| `security` | Security-sensitive issue; do not use for private disclosures. |

Use `good first issue` only after providing acceptance criteria, relevant file locations, and a maintainer contact for questions.
